data_description.room_sensor: The sensor that measures the temperature you actually care about.
data_description.night_entity: A schedule, input_boolean or binary_sensor. While it is on, the room uses its night temperature (set on the device page or the dashboard).
data_description.window_open_delay: How long a window or door must stay open before the TRVs turn off. Walking through a door shouldn't turn the heating off. Default 60.
data_description.window_close_delay: How long it must stay closed before heating resumes. Default 0.
data_description.outdoor_sensor: Optional. Lets Smart TRV react to cold nights before the room cools down.
data_description.preheat: Learns how fast the room warms and starts early, so it is warm when the night schedule ends. Needs a schedule as night schedule.
data_description.heats_rooms: Does this room have a wood stove or another heat source? Choose the other rooms its heat reaches. They then also stop learning while it burns.
data_description.presence: Optional. E.g. zone.home (people at home) or a person. When nobody has been home for 30 min, the room keeps its away temperature (set on the device page).
data_description.return_time: Optional. An input_datetime with when you are back. While nobody is home, the room keeps its away temperature and warms up in time for your return.
data_description.summer_off: Needs an outdoor sensor. Turns heating off once it has averaged over 16 °C outside for a day, and back on under 14 °C. Meanwhile the valves are exercised once a week.
data_description.sun_learning: Needs a weather entity. Learns when the sun warms the room and turns down a little ahead of it on sunny days.

advanced.name: Advanced
advanced.description: Not needed: Kp/Ki tune themselves and the rest is fixed or read from the TRV. Kp/Ki here are only the starting point for auto-tuning.

data_description.auto_tune: Once a day: lower Kp/Ki if the room oscillated, raise Ki if it stayed off target.
data_description.kp: Starting value. Auto-tuning adjusts it once a day (see kp on the climate entity). Default 3.0.
data_description.ki: Starting value. Auto-tuning adjusts it once a day (see ki on the climate entity). Default 1.0.
data_description.outdoor_gain: Extra TRV °C per °C between room target and outdoors. 0 turns it off. Default 0.1.

reset_integral.name: Reset learned offset
reset_integral.description: Forget the learned integral and start again from the TRV/room sensor difference.
